data.gender_notes: Firqad is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Firqad is derived from the Arabic word 'Faraqa' which means to separate or divide. It implies guidance, leadership, or being a trailblazer in one's path. The name Firqad carries the meaning “Guide, Leader” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in English, Urdu, Hindi. Parents who choose Firqad usually hope their child will grow to embody guide, leader and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: One who leads others towards the right path, guided by divine wisdom.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Firqad total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.

data.cultural_impact: The name Firqad carries a historical significance in Islamic culture, as it is associated with the Muhajirun or the Emigrants, a group of early Muslims who left their homes in Mecca and Medina to establish the Islamic state in Medina. The term Firqa was used to refer to this distinct group of Muslims, underscoring their unique identity, and their unwavering commitment to their faith and community.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name Firqad can be seen as a reminder to stay true to one's faith and to stand apart from negative influences in life. The name inspires individuals to be leaders in their own spiritual journeys and to seek guidance and strength in their connection to Allah. Ultimately, Firqad embodies the idea of being a trailblazer on the path to spiritual growth and enlightenment.
